about: The Slow Rush by Tame Impala, release group c6fc678e-e987-45c5-811c-e2bd09c8b902, as MusicBrainz answered /release?release-group=...&inc=media+recordings+labels+artist-credits on 2026-09-30 - trimmed to the fields deadwax reads. Ten pressings, nine sharing one tracklist: the Japanese CD adds "Patience", and one digital release has the single mix of "Borderline" (4:34, against the album's 3:58). 'expected' is what interface/scripts/tracklistDiff.mjs answered; ui/test/tracklist.sim.cjs holds it and the TypeScript port (ui/src/lib/tracklistDiff.ts) to it.
